channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: On the Agenda: What’s happening in France this week
item.description: Pancake day, important dates for voters, the end of the winter sales, the start of the 2026 Six Nations and the Winter Olympics, and the first wave of the winter holidays.

item.title: French expression of the day: Avoir d'autres chats à fouetter
item.description: It doesn't have anything to do with actually whipping cats.

item.title: Is Paris really going to ban second homes?
item.description: The city of Paris has been introducing more stringent measures against second homes, in an attempt to ease the capital's housing shortage, but will it really go as far as banning them altogether?

item.title: La Chandeleur: Why do the French eat crêpes on February 2nd?
item.description: It's La Chandeleur on Monday - the day when France goes pancake mad. Before you start cooking up your crêpes, take a moment to learn about the history (and superstitions) surrounding this French tradition.

item.title: New Paris passport office for South Africans in France
item.description: South Africans living in France get a slightly easier passport renewal process with the opening of a new passport centre in Paris.

item.title: REVEALED: The best French towns for quality of life in 2026
item.description: From transport and employment opportunities to green space, leisure opportunities and life expectancy, the French towns association has released its annual ranking of 'towns where life is good'.

item.title: France demands €1.7 billion in payroll taxes from Uber
item.description: Ride-sharing group Uber has been told by French authorities that it owes €1.7 billion ($2 billion) in unpaid payroll taxes, according to a media report Monday.

item.title: EU says countries can halt EES checks over summer to avoid travel chaos
item.description: Member States will have the green light to partially suspend Europe's Entry/Exit System (EES), the new EU digital border system, over the summer to avoid any travel chaos at ports and airports during peak season.

item.title: Epstein links lead to French film producer's resignation
item.description: The daughter of former high-profile French culture minister Jack Lang resigned as head of a film producers' group on Monday following revelations about family links to sex offender US financier Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: French PM ends budget deadlock after no confidence motions beaten
item.description: France adopted a 2026 government budget on Monday following months of fraught negotiations after Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu survived the latest in a string of no-confidence motions.
